The season began on 23 August 2025 and concluded on 24 May 2026. [[SSC Napoli|Napoli]] were the defending champions, having won their fourth Serie A title in the previous season. [[Inter Milan]] won their 21st title with three matches to spare on 3 May 2026, following a 2–0 home win against [[Parma Calcio 1913|Parma]].{{cite news |date=3 May 2026 |title=Inter cruise to Serie A title triumph after Thuram sparks victory over Parma |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/may/03/inter-win-serie-a-title-parma-football-italy |access-date=3 May 2026 |work=The Guardian |issn=0261-3077}} On 8 February 2026, a match between [[AC Milan|Milan]] and [[Como 1907|Como]] was scheduled to be held at [[Perth Stadium]] in Australia. Had it gone ahead, it would have been the first match from one of Europe's top five leagues to be played outside Europe.{{cite web |last=Ariadi |first=Nana |date=13 October 2025 |title=Club Statement on Potential Serie A Game in Perth |url=https://comofootball.com/en/club-statement-on-potential-serie-a-game-in-perth/ |access-date=19 October 2025 |publisher=Como 1907 }} The fixture was scheduled to take place two days after the opening ceremony of the [[2026 Winter Olympics]] at [[San Siro]] in the city of [[Milan]], which rendered the stadium unavailable for the match;{{cite news|date=10 June 2025|title=Serie A in talks to play Milan vs Como in Australia as first European league match abroad|url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/6416359/2025/06/10/milan-como-abroad-perth-australia/|work=The Athletic|access-date=31 January 2026|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251029061454/https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/6416359/2025/06/10/milan-como-abroad-perth-australia/|archive-date=29 October 2025|last1=Rai|first1=Guillermo|last2=Crafton|first2=Adam|url-status=live}} however, the match did not take place following a joint statement by the [[Government of Western Australia]] and Lega Serie A, which attributed the decision to what they described as the [[Asian Football Confederation]]'s "escalation of further unacceptable demands".{{cite news |last1=Hanlon |first1=Andrew |last2=Ho |first2=Cason |date=22 December 2025 |title=Landmark Italian league game in Perth cancelled over 'unacceptable demands' |url=https://www.abc.net.au/news/2025-12-23/ac-milan-versus-como-serie-a-game-at-perth-stadium-called-off/106173042 |access-date=29 December 2025 |work=ABC News}} == Teams == Twenty teams competed: the top seventeen teams from the previous season and three promoted teams from [[2024–25 Serie B|Serie B]]. The promoted teams included the two top teams from the Serie B table, and the winner of the promotion play-offs. [[US Sassuolo Calcio|Sassuolo]] returned to [[Serie A]] after one year away, becoming the first team to secure promotion, following their 3–1 victory over [[Modena FC 2018|Modena]] and [[Spezia Calcio|Spezia]]'s 2–2 draw with [[Mantova 1911|Mantova]].{{cite news |last=Maurelli |first=Niccolò |date=13 April 2025 |title=Sassuolo promosso in serie A. I segreti della squadra di Fabio Grosso, dallo psicologo alla dieta |url=https://www.repubblica.it/sport/calcio/serie-b/2025/04/13/news/sassuolo_promosso_serie_a-424125911/ |work=La Repubblica}} On the other end of the table, [[AC Monza|Monza]] were the first team to be relegated to [[2025–26 Serie B|Serie B]], following a 0–4 loss to [[Atalanta BC|Atalanta]], bringing an end to their three-year stint in Serie A. The remaining two relegation spots were decided on the final matchday, 25 May 2025, with [[Venezia FC|Venezia]] and [[Empoli FC|Empoli]] going down after their respective 2–3 and 1–2 losses to [[Juventus FC|Juventus]] and [[Hellas Verona FC|Hellas Verona]], ending their one and four-year spells in the league. [[Pisa SC|Pisa]] made their return to Italy's top league following a 34-year absence, their longest in club history, after defeating [[SSC Bari|Bari]] 1–0, combined with Spezia's 1–2 loss to [[AC Reggiana 1919|Reggiana]].{{cite news |date=4 May 2025 |title=Filippo Inzaghi's Pisa return to Serie A after 34 years |url=https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/filippo-inzaghis-pisa-return-serie-after-34-years-2025-05-04/ |access-date=30 May 2025 |agency=Reuters}} The final team to earn promotion was [[US Cremonese|Cremonese]], who returned to the top flight after a two-year absence, following a 0–0 draw at home and a 3–2 away victory over Spezia in the second leg of the play-off final on 1 June.{{cite news |last=Boccucci |first=Massimo |date=1 June 2025 |title=Serie B, Cremonese promossa in A grazie alla vittoria per 3-2 a La Spezia |url=https://www.ilmessaggero.it/sport/calcio/serie_b_cremonese_promossa_grazie_vittoria_3_2_la_spezia-8872690.html |work=Il Messaggero}} === Team changes === {| class="wikitable" !Promoted from
